tasks.title: Initialize React Calculator Project
tasks.description: Scaffold a new React project using Vite with TypeScript template. Install dependencies including React, React-DOM, and testing libraries (Vitest, @testing-library/react). Set up basic project structure with src/components directory. Configure Vite and ensure the dev server runs.
acceptance_criteria: Project structure created with src/components directory

tasks.title: Implement Display Component
tasks.description: Create a Display component that shows the calculator's current input and results. The component should accept a value prop and render it in a styled display area. Include proper TypeScript types for props. Style the display with a clean, readable design that shows numbers right-aligned.
acceptance_criteria: Component accepts value prop and renders it
Component is exported for use in Calculator

tasks.title: Implement Button Component
tasks.description: Create a reusable Button component for calculator digits (0-9), operations (+, -, ×, ÷), decimal point, equals (=), and clear (C). The component should accept label and onClick props. Include proper TypeScript types. Style buttons with clear visual feedback (hover, active states). Use CSS Grid or Flexbox for button layout in the calculator.
acceptance_criteria: Component accepts label and onClick props
Buttons are styled with hover/active states
Component is reusable for all button types
Component is exported for use in Calculator

tasks.title: Implement Calculator Component with Arithmetic Logic
tasks.description: Create the main Calculator component that integrates Display and Button components. Implement state management using React hooks (useState) to track current value, previous value, and selected operation. Implement arithmetic logic for addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. Handle edge cases: division by zero (display 'Error'), decimal point input, consecutive operations, and clear functionality. Create a responsive button grid layout with digits (0-9), operations (+, -, ×, ÷), decimal (.), equals (=), and clear (C). Update App.tsx to render the Calculator component.
acceptance_criteria: Calculator component integrates Display and Button
State management handles current value, previous value, and operation
Calculator is fully functional in the browser

tasks.title: Write Tests for Display Component
tasks.description: Write unit tests for the Display component using Vitest and @testing-library/react. Test that the component renders correctly, accepts and displays the value prop, and handles different input types (numbers, strings, 'Error'). Ensure tests cover edge cases like empty values and long numbers.
acceptance_criteria: Test file created for Display component
Tests verify value prop is displayed correctly
Tests cover edge cases (empty, long numbers, 'Error')
All tests are runnable with Vitest

tasks.title: Write Tests for Button Component
tasks.description: Write unit tests for the Button component using Vitest and @testing-library/react. Test that the component renders with the correct label, onClick handler is called when clicked, and different button types (digits, operations, special) render correctly. Test accessibility and keyboard interaction if applicable.
acceptance_criteria: Test file created for Button component
Tests verify button renders with label
Tests verify onClick handler is triggered
All tests are runnable with Vitest

tasks.title: Write Tests for Calculator Logic
tasks.description: Write comprehensive integration and unit tests for the Calculator component using Vitest and @testing-library/react. Test all arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division) with various inputs. Test error handling (division by zero). Test edge cases: consecutive operations, decimal point handling, clearing the calculator, long number sequences, and operation chaining. Simulate user interactions (clicking buttons) and verify display updates correctly.
acceptance_criteria: Test file created for Calculator component
Tests verify all arithmetic operations work correctly
Tests verify division by zero displays 'Error'
All tests are runnable with Vitest

tasks.title: Validate Calculator Test Suite
tasks.description: Run the complete test suite for all calculator components (Display, Button, Calculator) using Vitest. Verify all tests pass. Report any failures with details. Ensure test coverage meets acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Test output is captured and reviewed
Any failures are reported with details

tasks.title: Runtime Browser Verification
tasks.description: Start the Vite dev server and launch the calculator application in a browser using Playwright. Take a screenshot of the calculator UI. Verify that: the calculator renders correctly, all buttons are visible and properly laid out, the display shows '0' initially, clicking number buttons updates the display, performing a simple calculation (e.g., 2 + 3 = 5) works correctly, and the clear button resets the display. Save screenshot to screenshots/ directory.
acceptance_criteria: UI is responsive and buttons are clickable
No runtime errors in browser console

tasks.title: Commit Calculator Application
tasks.description: Create a git commit with all calculator components (Display, Button, Calculator), tests, configuration files, and project setup. Use a clear commit message: 'feat: implement mini calculator with React'. Ensure all files are staged and committed properly.
acceptance_criteria: Commit message is clear and descriptive
